faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
faq.a1: FlashMatch is a paid dating platform. Women publish their rates, men pay 1 token to send a date request. If she accepts, the date takes place at the listed rates and payment is made in person.
faq.q2: What are tokens and how much does a request cost?
faq.a2: Tokens are FlashMatch's currency. Sending a date request costs 1 token. If the request is declined or expires without an answer, the token is refunded automatically.
faq.a3: Yes, signing up and creating a profile are free. Women use the app for free; men buy tokens to send requests.
faq.a4: Security is our priority. To get the 'Verified Profile' badge, you need to submit a real-time selfie with your face clearly visible. Our team reviews it to make sure you are who you say you are.
faq.a5: Absolutely. We use advanced encryption technologies to protect your personal data. We will never share your information with third parties without your explicit consent. Read our Privacy Policy for more details.
faq.a6: After a confirmed meeting through the app, both users can leave a review. This helps maintain high community quality and rewards correct and respectful users. Only real meetings can be reviewed.
faq.a7: Certainly. You can delete your account at any time from your profile settings. Please note that this action is irreversible and all your data, including unused tokens, will be lost.
faq.q8: Does the appointment obligate me to anything?
faq.a8: Absolutely not. A scheduled meeting is in no way binding and does not entitle anyone to demand anything from the other person. The only obligation is to show up and try to have fun and spend quality time together. Whatever happens, happens — but always respecting the other person's wishes.
faq.noAnswer: Didn't find the answer you were looking for?
faq.notFound: Didn't find the answer you were looking for?
faq.a9: Each woman sets her own rates (duration, price, description) from her profile. They are visible before sending a request and payment is made directly in person during the date: FlashMatch does not handle that payment.

terms.seoDescription: Read FlashMatch's terms and conditions. Rules of conduct, limitations of liability, and community guidelines.
terms.seoKeywords: terms of service, terms and conditions, dating regulations
terms.introText: Welcome to FlashMatch. By using our website and services, you agree to comply with and be bound by the following terms and conditions. Please read them carefully.
terms.liabilityText1: FlashMatch acts exclusively as an intermediary to facilitate the organization of appointments between users.
terms.liabilityText2: It is important to understand that FlashMatch only and exclusively deals with organizing the appointment. Once the appointment has been set and the parties have been put in contact, we have no responsibility, control or obligation regarding what happens afterwards, either online or offline.
terms.liabilityText3: We are not responsible for the actions, behaviors or conduct of any user, either online or offline. The user is solely responsible for their own interactions with other members.
terms.eligibilityText: You must be at least 18 years old to use this service. By using FlashMatch, you represent and warrant that you have the right, authority and capacity to accept these Terms and comply with them.
terms.conductText: You agree not to use the service for illegal or prohibited purposes. It is forbidden to harass, intimidate or defame other users. We reserve the right to suspend or terminate your account if you violate these rules.
terms.modificationsText: We reserve the right to modify these terms at any time. Changes will be effective immediately upon posting on the site. Continued use of the service after such changes constitutes acceptance of the new terms.
terms.ratesText: Female users freely set their own rates for dates. Male users pay 1 token to send a date request: the token is automatically refunded if the request is declined or expires unanswered. Tokens are platform usage credits and do not constitute payment of the rate.
terms.paymentText: The agreed rate is paid directly in person between the parties, outside the platform. FlashMatch does not collect, manage or guarantee this payment in any way and is not responsible for non-payment, disputes or agreements made between users.
terms.nonBindingText: A scheduled date is in no way binding to demand anything from the other person. The only commitment is to show up and spend quality time together, always fully respecting the other person's will. Any coercive behaviour or demand for services results in immediate account suspension.

privacy.seoDescription: FlashMatch privacy policy. Learn how we collect, use and protect your personal data.
privacy.seoKeywords: privacy policy, data protection, GDPR, dating privacy
privacy.collectionText: We collect the information you provide directly when you register, create a profile or communicate with us. This may include your name, email address, date of birth, gender and meeting preferences.
privacy.useIntro: We use the collected information to:
privacy.useItem1: Provide, maintain and improve our services.
privacy.useItem2: Facilitate the organization of appointments between users.
privacy.useItem3: Send you technical communications, security updates and administrative messages.
privacy.useItem4: Monitor and analyze trends and service usage.
privacy.sharingText: We do not sell your personal information to third parties. We share your information only with other users as necessary to facilitate appointments (for example, by showing your profile to other compatible users) or when required by law.
privacy.securityText: We take reasonable measures to protect your information from loss, theft, misuse and unauthorized access. However, no security system is impenetrable and we cannot guarantee the absolute security of our databases.
privacy.rightsText: You have the right to access, correct or delete your personal information at any time by accessing your profile or contacting us directly.

cookie.seoDescription: FlashMatch cookie policy. Learn which cookies we use and how to manage your preferences.
cookie.seoKeywords: cookie policy, cookie management, cookie privacy
cookie.whatAreText: Cookies are small text files that are saved on your device when you visit a website. They are widely used to make websites work more efficiently, as well as to provide information to site owners.
cookie.howWeUseIntro: We use cookies for various purposes, including:
cookie.essentialText: Necessary for the operation of the site. They include, for example, cookies that allow you to access protected areas of our site.
cookie.analyticsText: Allow us to recognize and count the number of visitors and see how visitors move around the site when they use it. This helps us improve how our site works.
cookie.functionalText: Used to recognize you when you return to our site. This allows us to personalize our content for you and remember your preferences.
cookie.managementText: Most web browsers automatically accept cookies, but you can usually change your browser settings to refuse cookies if you prefer. However, this may prevent you from taking full advantage of the website.
cookie.changesText: We may update this Cookie Policy from time to time. We encourage you to periodically check this page for any changes.
